title: AnalysisResult
description: What the service returns for one document. It describes the document; it decides nothing about the business.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Bumped by the rules in PRD section 9.

file_sha256.description: Hash of the received file. The service keeps no copy: this is how the caller correlates and detects resubmission on its own side.

value.description: Document types supported by the registry. A new type is a new enum value, which is a minor change only because consumers must tolerate unknown values.

fields.description: Extracted fields, keyed by field name. The key set depends on the document type and is documented in openapi.yaml. Keeping it a map is what lets a new document type ship without a new schema version.

validations.description: Deterministic integrity rules run over the extracted fields. No model involved.

knowledge.description: Internal norms retrieved for this document. Absent when enrichment is unavailable; see capabilities.

confidence.description: Composed from OCR confidence, model confidence and the deterministic validations.

evidence.description: The literal excerpt of recognised text the value came from, verified in code against the source text.

field.description: One extracted field. When abstained is true, value is null and reason says why. A field is never filled by guessing and never inferred when absent from the document.

value.description: Shape depends on the field: string, number, object or array. Null when abstained or when the field is absent from the document.

reason.description: Stable code explaining a null value.

review.description: Whether the case needs a human. The service decides that a human is needed; the review itself happens in the consumer, which owns the screen and the flow.

reasons.description: Stable codes. Field-scoped reasons carry the field after a colon, for example confidence_below_threshold:leave_period.

capabilities.description: Explicit degradation. The analysis still returns; this says what was unavailable while producing it.

provenance.description: What is needed to reproduce this analysis later from the same file.
